context: Independent phase B addendum; no new blind run; does not modify r1/r2.

items.claim: JLS 17.7 says reads/writes of references are always atomic regardless of 32/64-bit implementation; the section primarily describes non-atomic treatment of non-volatile long/double and guarantees volatile long/double atomicity.

source.checked_claim: §17.7 lines 668-674: non-volatile long/double may be split; volatile long/double and reference reads/writes are atomic

items.scope: Supports theory statement that reference reads/writes are individually atomic; does not support compound get-then-set atomicity.

items.claim: AtomicReference get/set are individual volatile-effect accessors; getAndUpdate/updateAndGet atomically update with a function; contention can cause function reapplication.

source.checked_claim: get has VarHandle.getVolatile effects; set has VarHandle.setVolatile effects; updateAndGet is atomic and may reapply side-effect-free function under contention

items.scope: Supports distinction in Q25 theory between individual reference accesses and atomic update protocol.

items.claim: AtomicInteger.incrementAndGet atomically increments and returns updated value.

source.checked_claim: incrementAndGet atomically increments and returns updated value; equivalent to addAndGet(1)

items.scope: Supports Q25 theory example contrasting atomic increment with get-then-set.

items.claim: Virtual threads are daemon threads and do not prevent the Java shutdown sequence from beginning.

source.checked_claim: Virtual threads section explicitly states virtual threads are daemon threads and do not prevent shutdown sequence from beginning

items.scope: Supports Q46 edge_cases claim; prior R2 evidence only checked builder daemon configuration, which was insufficient for this claim.
